<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/projects/{projectId}/code/pull-requests/{pullRequestId}/diff"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



A null `patch` distinguishes the case where the provider didn't deliver the text (binary, or a patch too large) from the case where the text came back empty. Collapsing the two would make the screen say a changed binary didn't change. The `truncated` field warns when the file list went past the cap.
